6.steps: 1) Configure a VPN Policy on the local firewall. Set SA lifetime to at least 300 seconds. Enable KeepAlive . 2) Configure the matching VPN Policy on the remote firewall. 3) When the tunnel is built, go to Network>Address Objects page on the local firewall and edit the address object that is used by VPN policy as a remote network. Change the network.
6.title: New IKE negotiation is attempted after Address Objects used by the VPN policy changes
6.result: The existing tunnel gets deleted on the local box. The local box should start IKE negotiation after that.

4.steps: 1) Configure a VPN Policy on the local firewall. Set SA lifetime to at least 300 seconds. Enable KeepAlive . 2) Configure the matching VPN Policy on the remote firewall. 3) Wait for SA lifetime to expire.
4.title: New IKE negotiation is attempted after SA lifetime expires
4.result: The local box should start IKE negotiation after SA lifetime expires.

1.steps: 1) Configure a VPN Policy on the local firewall. Set SA lifetime to at least 300 seconds. Enable KeepAlive . 2) Configure the matching VPN Policy on the remote firewall. 3) Restart the local firewall.
1.title: New IKE negotiation is attempted after startup/bootup
1.result: The local box should start IKE negotiation after reboot.

3.steps: 1) Configure a VPN Policy on the local firewall. Set SA lifetime to at least 300 seconds. Enable KeepAlive . 2) Configure the matching VPN Policy on the remote firewall. 3) When the tunnel is built, change the preshared secret on the local firewall.
3.title: New IKE negotiation is attempted after negotiation failure due to errors
3.result: The local box should delete the old SA and start a new negotiation. The negotiation will fail due to unmatched preshared secret. When the negotiation is aborted due to timeout, a next new IKE negotiation will start, and so on.

2.steps: 1) Configure a VPN Policy on the local firewall. Set SA lifetime to at least 300 seconds. Enable KeepAlive . 2) Configure the matching VPN Policy on the remote firewall. 3) When the tunnel is built, change preshared secret on the both local and remote firewalls.
2.title: New IKE negotiation is attempted after Add/Modify VPN policy
2.result: The local box should start IKE negotiation after VPN policies on the both firewalls have been modified.

5.steps: 1) Configure a VPN Policy on the local firewall. Set SA lifetime to at least 300 seconds. Enable KeepAlive . 2) Configure the matching VPN Policy on the remote firewall.Enable DPD 3) When the tunnel is built, manually disconnect the cable on the WAN port of th e local box. 4) Wait for remote firewall to tear down the tunnel after sending appropriate number of DPD messages.
5.title: New IKE negotiation is attempted after DPD tears down a tunnel
5.result:
Remote firewall will send DPD requests and won't get replies from a peer. After the appropriate number of DPD messages (set on VPN> advansed page) the existing tunnels will be torn down.
  The local box should start IKE negotiation after that.
